invariants.rationale: Rendering methods typically require the Batch parameter to be non-null to proceed with drawing operations safely.
Alpha values for drawing (opacity) are conventionally required to be within [0,1], so must at least be non-negative.
Alpha composing operations typically assume alpha is at most 1.0 for drawing transparency.
Widgets participating in scene2d UI usually have an associated Stage, accessible via getStage().
Drawing operations are only meaningful if the WidgetGroup is visible; isVisible() reflects this.
